schedule.verification: Only the frozen commit object and subject were verified; no schedule file or reviewer artifact was read.

contract.causality: A subject must add a security-relevant delta whose parent lacks that delta; blame and SZZ are leads only.
contract.ancestry: The accepted mainline carrier must be an ancestor of the named fix parent.
contract.attribution: Frozen carrier-level observable AI attribution accepts an exact carrier's raw author, committer, trailer, or a recoverable squash PR member. Hunk-level authorship is reported separately and is not substituted for the frozen carrier-level definition.

summary.counting_note: A unique subject is counted once per case even when it introduced several independently fixed sinks. Semantic edges count the independently testable security mechanisms or sinks listed under each accepted subject.

mechanism_at_fix_parent.entry: Explicit --http/--server mode creates a Node HTTP server; --host 0.0.0.0 remains an advertised container configuration even though the default had already been changed to 127.0.0.1.
security_edges: All non-health HTTP requests reached MCP handling without an application bearer-token check.
POST bodies were accumulated into an unbounded Buffer[] before JSON parsing, permitting memory exhaustion.
The Node server retained the default unlimited maxConnections value, leaving connection/SSE exhaustion uncapped.
mechanism_at_fix_parent.fix_delta: The fix adds optional bearer-token validation, a 1 MiB streaming body limit, and maxConnections=100.

fix_scope_caveat.finding: At 8f12972481e9165e8bd24d63b0a9e71976f85a43, authentication is enforced only when MCP_BEARER_TOKEN is set; when it is absent the server warns and still accepts unauthenticated requests.
fix_scope_caveat.later_hardening: 61676d715d6df932b00e159a68a669400dd970ae later makes the token mandatory and exits at startup when it is absent.
fix_scope_caveat.adjudication: The named fix closes body and connection exhaustion and adds an authentication capability, but it does not itself eliminate the no-token fail-open configuration. This is recorded as fix scope, not used to erase the causal-origin result.

fix_attribution_not_origin.evidence: The fix commit contains Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>.

counterfactual.evidence: The carrier parent 32d7a2dd7544275f4c92f3b563212a763c9a0104 has no HTTP server mode. The carrier adds createServer(), the unbounded chunk loop, and no auth or maxConnections setting; removing the carrier removes the entire vulnerable HTTP surface.

attribution.evidence: The exact squash carrier contains Co-authored-by: Copilot <175728472+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>.
attribution.member_evidence: Recoverable PR #107 shows 6cca70b23c068cd862ec0420d126387eed0436d6 added the HTTP server and vulnerable loop under Christian Kreuzberger. The Copilot-attributed member d2e79dd7b49facab72b8752f8da96c780d1e9806 only changed `let body: unknown = undefined` to `let body: unknown`. Those PR members are not mainline ancestors; the squash carrier is.
attribution.boundary: Accepted under the frozen carrier-level trailer rule; this does not claim that Copilot authored the vulnerable hunk atomically.

rejected_exact_subjects.reason: Recoverable PR member containing the atomic vulnerable HTTP delta, but it is human-authored and is not a mainline ancestor; it is represented by accepted squash carrier 00b7649.
Has a Copilot trailer but changes only a redundant initializer; its parent already contains every security flaw, so counterfactual causality fails.

Later multiple-connection/stateless refactor. Its parent already has unauthenticated HTTP, unbounded body buffering, and no Node connection cap; not the first causal carrier and no observable AI attribution.

Claude-coauthored per-request server refactor may amplify concurrency, but reverting it retains the no-auth surface, unbounded body loop, and uncapped HTTP server. It is not necessary for the direct mechanisms fixed by 8f129.
Fix parent is a mitigation that changes the default host from 0.0.0.0 to 127.0.0.1; explicit public binding remains. It does not introduce the reviewed defects.
AI-attributed fix, not a causal origin.
Post-fix fail-closed hardening, not an origin and not in the named fix ancestry window.

mechanism_at_fix_parent.flow: MCP tool schemas accept strings, callbacks pass them to capability helpers, helpers interpolate them into DQL templates, and executeDql sends the resulting query to QueryExecutionClient.queryExecute().
fixed_sink_classes: timeframe inserted into now()-${timeframe} without grammar validation
additionalFilter inserted as a raw DQL pipeline fragment
entity and cluster identifiers inserted into DQL double-quoted strings without escaping
mechanism_at_fix_parent.reachability_note: eventType is already constrained by a z.enum at the MCP boundary; its additional escaping is defense in depth, not counted as an independently exploitable origin edge.
